verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair privacy question for a SaaS recruiting platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no first-party documentation of any telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for Ashby users. The only opt-out mentioned is a candidate-facing form for AI resume processing, which is a different control and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
